neighbours.label: Word of mouth: telling, recommending or sharing something with friends and family; fires at or just before the telling word (output promotes ' share', ' tell', ' recommend', ' spread')
fire: The haircut was perfect and the price was fair. I have already recommended the salon to my sister.
When readers enjoy a novel, they tell their friends about it and sales grow.
Fast shipping and lovely packaging. I will be telling all my colleagues about this store.
Members earn a discount for referring a friend to the gym.
We were so pleased with the plumber that we passed his name on to our neighbours.
If you liked this video, please share it with your family and friends.
Our guests loved the cabin and said they would recommend it to everyone they know.
The best advertising is a happy customer telling a friend about your product.
quiet: The haircut took forty minutes and the salon is on the second floor of the mall.
When readers finish a novel, they put it back on the shelf and pick another.
Slow shipping and torn packaging. I have asked the store to send my money back.
Members pay a monthly fee for using the pool at the gym.
The plumber arrived at nine, replaced the valve and left before lunch.
This video is twelve minutes long and was filmed in a small studio.
The cabin has two bedrooms, a wood stove and a view of the lake.
The best time to water a lawn is early in the morning before the heat.

notes: Probes: recommending/telling sentences 0.53-0.90; plain product descriptions 0.00; a complaint 0.08. A satisfied review followed by 'I have already booked a table' also scored 0.83 at ' already': the pole fires in anticipation of the recommending word after praise, so praise-only near misses would leak.
